dot.position: third line, immediately left of the existing update/date label

greenWhen: the current collection produced a valid positive payload for the asset
the row has a valid non-future fetchedAt
the row is not marked cached/catalog fallback; an archive row is green only when its current origin is github-verified-snapshot
the persisted source evidence is no older than five minutes
grayWhen: missing or invalid payload, including HTTP 200 without a valid payload
cache, bundled/historical archive, catalog fallback or timeout-preserved data
a previous fresh result has expired
accessibility: The dot describes recent source-query evidence for the displayed asset; it does not indicate that a market or exchange is open.
preparedTapCache: A prepared result may be reused for five seconds only with the same persisted row evidence; it does not renew the source timestamp.
preserved: row refresh intent and native plain-button feedback
three-line block centered on the icon
fixed order, data, sources, curves and external dimensions
tests: valid live payload turns one row green
invalid payload and HTTP-200-without-payload cannot turn green
partial collection keeps valid rows green and failed rows gray
small/medium/large retain the same 3 pt dot before the date
tap success, rejection and timeout preserve the cache and do not accept late persistence
